newsitem.title: UK: Gencor to issue Billiton prospectus.
newsitem.headline: Gencor to issue Billiton prospectus.

text.p: South African mining group Gencor Ltd said on Friday it would publish the prospectus for the planned London Stock Market flotation of its base metal division Billiton on July 7.
Analysts estimated that company would be valued at between four and 4.2 billion stg. Billiton was expected to raise around 600 million stg from the float.
Billiton was set to become the second mining group in the FTSE 100, joining Rio Tinto Plc which has a market capitalisation of about 22 billion stg.
Emil Morfett, mining analyst at Paribas Capital Markets, said the issue would be attractive as Billiton had strong management and low levels of debt.
"It's an extremely high quality company, it has everything you could wish for," said Morfett.
"The only problem is that it has 75 percent of its assets in South Africa and for that reason it would not deserve as high a rating as Rio Tinto."
